text:
Which statement about the element bromine is correct?
A
It displaces chlorine from aqueous potassium chloride.
B
It has a higher density than chlorine.
C
It is a diatomic metal.
D
It is a green gas at room temperature.

options.label: A
options.text: It displaces chlorine from aqueous potassium chloride.

options.label: B
options.text: It has a higher density than chlorine.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a green gas at room temperature.
